quest.title: The Empty Courtyard
quest.description: The Silvermoon Hall is bathed in silence today...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (As expected, Columbina isn't here...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could Columbina really...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (She stepped through the "Moon Gate." No one knows what's inside, but it's a place that tore apart the extremely powerful Rächer of Solnari...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (If only I'd...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Columbina?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you... also waiting for Columbina to come back?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, you too...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey... C'mon, don't be so sad. Keep your chin up...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If everyone was sad, that'd be like... like...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon doesn't want to think about it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (...I can't allow myself to wallow in guilt.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Columbina didn't sacrifice herself for us to end up like this, not to mention...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I... haven't given up yet.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Columbina, all of her friends... None of them would ever just give up like this...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Give us a little more time. I can't promise anything, but I'll do everything I can...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are they... cheering for us?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thank you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you need us to help you with something?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This kuuhenki... Paimon thinks it's the one who likes playing the lyre.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This kuuhenki... Paimon thinks she looks a little flustered...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why don't you play something? If they hear a familiar melody, maybe they'll calm down a little bit...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A familiar melody...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's try the one Columbina always sings...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aww... They're asleep.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like they haven't had a good rest in a long time...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shh, let's leave.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sandrone! What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: What, am I not allowed to take walks now?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She hasn't returned.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Thought as much.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: No such thing as a free miracle, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, which way are you headed? Er, Paimon means... We don't see much of each other, maybe we could join you for a bit?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Let's not. I'm not in a good mood today, and don't have anything nice to say.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Besides, comfort is the last thing this place needs.
